architect.rationale: ClassificationLevel is the correct abstraction at this layer — it decouples operational sensitivity tiering from the raw 19-variant DataClass enum. DataClassMatcher removes copy-pasted matches! blocks from every downstream policy site. RetentionPolicy closes the loop on ADR-0008 purge obligations at the kernel layer.

guardrails: ClassificationLevel does not cover the full DataClass set exhaustively in a const fn — if a new DataClass variant is added in future, the compiler will enforce adding a ClassificationLevel arm (no silent fallthrough).

RetentionPolicy defaults are regulatory minimums per ADR-0008; jurisdiction overlays (e.g. GDPR 30d for PHI, PIPA 1y for personal data) are a follow-on delta under the same F-M02B-PLAN-LIVE-CRATE-RECONCILIATION reconciliation task.

DataClassMatcher::SearchIndexRestricted omits PiiIdentifying/PiiSensitive per the existing is_search_index_privacy_hard_denied logic in lib.rs — intentional alignment, but should be re-evaluated when the full CedarDubEvaluator is wired.
